name: NGC 691 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 691, a spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: n0691uvis-hubble
story: Layers of stars and winding spiral arms fill this galaxy, which gives its name to a small group of galaxies bound together by gravity. William Herschel discovered it nearly two centuries before Hubble launched.

claims.text: NGC 691 is a spiral galaxy imaged by Hubble's WFC3
It is the eponymous member of the NGC 691 galaxy group, a group of gravitationally bound galaxies
Discovered by William Herschel almost 200 years before Hubble launched
Hubble captured layers of stars and spiralling arms in NGC 691
N0691-UVIS is a spiral-galaxy target of program 15145 at the pointing position
